fichas.title: Miniature Golf
fichas.summary: A miniature golf course consists of 18 clearly separated, numbered lanes, except for driving shots. Competition lanes include a playing area, lane demarcations, a tee marking, usually one or more obstacles, optional borderline and set-down markings, and a hole. Additional components or markings may be specific to the lane system. Level playing areas must be completely flat; lane edges not formed by strips must be marked. Edge strips should support strategic play, obstacles should be practical and permanently installed, and the locations of non-fixed obstacles should be marked. The page illustrates multiple lane layouts and obstacle arrangements.
